name: Phoebe Dean
source:
Phoebe, or better known as "Fame", exploded into popularity after winning the 15th season of Tournament of Ink. She also happens to be the stepsister of Wolves quarterback, [url=/c148364]Blaine Fitzgerald[/url]. But it turns out [url=/c148291]MC[/url] and Fame have a more obscure connection than her own stepbrother.
